subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` become a supported public OpenClaw plugin SDK surface in this PR, or should the session refresh repair remain internal until the agent-core contract is synchronized separately?
rationale: The runtime repair needs per-turn context, but exporting a precedence-bearing hook establishes a compatibility-sensitive plugin API that automation cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve upstream-aligned hook
options.body: Keep the additive hook with its current precedence, document its relationship to `prepareNextTurn`, and require compatibility tests plus regenerated API baselines.

options.title: Keep refresh internal
options.body: Remove the public hook from this PR and implement the session wrapper's next-turn refresh through an internal adapter until the public contract is reviewed separately.

recommendation.title: Approve upstream-aligned hook
recommendation.body: Keep the additive hook with its current precedence, document its relationship to `prepareNextTurn`, and require compatibility tests plus regenerated API baselines.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across compaction, sessions, transcript-core integration, and the affected SDK boundary.
